_comment: Release-day settings. VERIFY data_release and table names against the DR4 archive on 2 Dec 2026.

control._comment: Control stars for the real-data null; verify table names on release day.
control.candidate_adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe FROM {table} WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', {ra}, {dec}, {radius})) AND phot_g_mean_mag BETWEEN {gmin} AND {gmax} AND ruwe < {max_ruwe}

rv_summary._comment: DR4 RV summary per source: SB2 indicator. Verify table/column names on release day.

autorun._comment: scripts/dr4_watch.py (unattended release day). window_start_utc: polling starts; DR4 is expected ~11:00 UTC 2 Dec.
